d: Long, flowing platinum white hair with a sharp center part and a frozen, crystalline texture. Pale lavender eyes with a cold, vacant expression. Apparent age is ancient and mature, though the face is frozen in a timeless state. A tall, slender build with pale, frost-toned skin. Wearing a heavy, ornate gown of deep midnight blue and silver armor plating. Signature details include a floating, crystalline frozen eye embedded in the forehead and a massive, ornate ice-crystal staff.
